heading.zh-Hant: 1939年北部邊境特別部隊指揮官
heading.en: Commander of the northern frontier force (Narew Group), 1939

body.zh-Hant: 美國陸軍戰史把Mlot-Fijalkowski少將列為北部一支特別部隊的指揮官，部署於比布扎河與納雷夫河一帶，負責守衛格羅德諾—華沙鐵路線以北的波蘭邊界。該部隊被稱為納雷夫集群，與其他以「軍」稱呼的波軍指揮單位不同。
body.en: The US Army history names Maj. Gen. Mlot-Fijalkowski as commander of a special force in the north, disposed along the Biebrza and Narew rivers and tasked with holding the Polish frontier north of the Grodno–Warsaw rail line. That force is called the Narew Group, unlike the other Polish commands, which are usually called armies.
